topics.title: What are Tokens?
topics.description: Tokens are small pieces of text that make up an AI model's context. Models process text as tokens rather than whole words, and token counts show how much context is being used.

image.alt: Comparison of how GPT-2, BERT, and T5 split the sentence The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Token counts and vocabulary sizes differ by tokenizer.
image.caption: The same sentence can be divided into different tokens by different models.
